items: In October, PAI Partners announced it entered into exclusive negotiations to acquire a majority stake in the Cyrus Group, a leading independent wealth management brand in France, through a strategic partnership with the Cyrus management team. Cyrus is a fast-growing platform, with over 20 billion in assets under management and an expanding customer base of more than 30,000 institutional and private clients. With PAI’s support, Cyrus would drive sustainable organic growth, increase product distribution and further build its platform through targeted consolidation opportunities across France and Europe. The transaction is subject to prior regulatory approvals and is expected to close in the second quarter of 2026.¹

In October, I Squared announced it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Liberty Tire Recycling from Energy Capital Partners. Liberty Tire Recycling is North America’s premier end-of-life recycling platform, providing comprehensive tire collection, processing and recycling solutions. The transaction adds Liberty to I Squared’s growing global portfolio of environmental infrastructure platforms and reinforces the firm’s commitment to building sustainable businesses that deliver both economic and environmental value.²

In October, DivcoWest, a DivCore Capital company, announced the acquisition of Vance Apartments, a Class A, 137-unit multifamily building located in San Francisco. This acquisition highlights the strength of DivcoWest’s residential relationships and ability to execute off-market transactions in highly competitive markets. Vance Apartments is steps from a National Historic Landmark District and the heart of San Francisco’s arts and culture scene. This closing exemplifies the profile DivcoWest is targeting which is newly delivered urban housing acquired at a compelling entry basis, with clear demand recovery and tangible opportunities to create value through execution.³

items: In December, Stonepeak and Energy Equation Partners announced the completion of their acquisition of a 65% interest in JET Tankstellen Deutschland GMbH, a leading fuel retailer in Germany and Austria, from a subsidiary of Phillips 66, in a transaction valuing the business at an enterprise value of approximately €2.5 billion. Stonepeak and Energy Equation Partners will bring an extensive network of service stations, a trusted brand and combined expertise to JET as they service its customers across Germany and Austria.¹

In December, CVC announced it entered into an agreement to acquire Smiths Detection, a global leader in threat-detection and security-screening technologies for airports and critical infrastructure, from Smiths Group plc for £2.0 billion. Smiths Detection has a global number one position in aviation security where it serves 47 of the world’s top 50 airports, with both industry-leading hardware and sector-leading digital capabilities, including automated detection algorithms.²

In December, H.I.G. announced the sale of United Flow Technologies to an affiliate of Berkshire Partners while retaining a minority stake. H.I.G. established the UFT platform in 2021 to serve the municipal and industrial water and wastewater market. During H.I.G.’s ownership, the company completed and integrated several add-on acquisitions, expanding its geographic presence, introducing new product lines, and growing its customer base. Through numerous strategic initiatives, investments, and synergistic add-on acquisitions, the UFT achieved significant growth during H.I.G.’s ownership period. ³

items: I Squared saw an approximate 17.3% increase in fair value, driven by the firm’s ongoing fundraising success, as well as launching its own private wealth fund, ISQ OpenInfra. The firm is also seeing some momentum in terms of underlying portfolio company exit activity.

Landmark was also marked up approximately 10.6%, as deal activity accelerated in their student housing portfolio. The firm is currently in market with its inaugural GP fund which will provide Landmark with capital for future investments.
Lastly, CVC saw an approximate 14.4% decrease driven by a decrease in the public stock price over the quarter and FX appreciation while PAI saw a one basis point increase driven by FX appreciation.

blocks.html: (4) Gross DPI Formula: (ITD Gross Distributions + Securitization Proceeds applied to Investment) / (Paid-In Cost – Credit Facility Funding applied to Investment). Securitization Proceeds applied to Investment are pro rata based on the fair value of the included Investments at the time of the debt issuance. Credit Facility Funding applied to Investment is generally pro rata based on Paid-In Cost as of the reporting date. This metric is calculated without the deduction of fees and expenses.

blocks.html: (5) Gross TVPI formula: (Holding Value – Future Tranches + ITD Gross Distributions + Securitization Proceeds applied to Investment – Credit Facility Funding applied to Investment – Securitization Net Debt applied to Investment) / (Paid-In Cost – Credit Facility Funding applied to Investment). Securitization Proceeds and Securitization Net Debt applied to Investment are pro rata based on the fair value of the included Investments at the time of the debt issuance. Credit Facility Funding applied to Investment is generally pro rata based on Paid-In Cost as of the reporting date. This metric is calculated without the deduction of fees and expenses.

blocks.html: (8) LP Net Blended IRR is computed based on inception-to-date contributions on the dates they were due and distributions on the dates they were paid and the LPs’ aggregate capital accounts as of the reporting date. LP Net Blended IRR shown is net of applicable fees and expenses based upon the net asset value as of the reporting date. LP Net Blended IRR excluding the Credit Facility for Fund V is 8.4%, which is computed based on inception-to-date contributions on the dates they were due and distributions on the dates they were paid adjusting all draws from and repayments to the Credit Facility to be treated as capital contributions and capital distributions to LPs on the dates they were made, and adjusting the ending LPs’ aggregate capital accounts as of the reporting date to exclude the effects of the Credit Facility (i.e., consideration of the assumed capital activity and the removal of fees and expenses related to the Credit Facility). LP Net Blended IRR includes the cash flows and NAVs of all LPs, excluding the SLP.

blocks.html: Performance Information:

Where performance returns have been included in this material, Blue Owl has included herein important information relating to the calculation of these returns as well as other pertinent performance related definitions.The performance information displayed for certain funds managed by partner managers were selected on the basis of the three latest flagship fund vintages in their harvesting period and any subsequent flagship fund raised where Blue Owl is permitted to disclose such performance information. For these purposes, Blue Owl defines a fund’s “harvesting period” as the fund’s post-investment period before final liquidation and the "subsequent flagship fund raised" as any flagship fund that has held a final close and has begun collecting management fees, but is not yet in its harvesting period. Accordingly, in certain instances, a partner manager may have less than three flagship fund vintages which are in their harvesting period and in such instances only those flagship fund vintages, if any, which are in their harvesting period are displayed. Additionally, in certain instances, there may not be a subsequent flagship fund raised and the flagship fund vintages in their harvesting period are the latest funds to show. This performance information is being provided solely for discussion purposes to provide illustrative examples of flagship funds managed by the partner managers and does not reflect the performance of any Blue Owl Fund (as defined herein), or subset of investments of a Fund, managed by Blue Owl or its affiliates. For partner managers whose primary investments are hedge fund strategies, the flagship strategy is displayed.
